description: Full detail for one mission step: objective, deliverables, acceptance criteria, pace options, approach options, base IVP.

description.name: start_mission
description.description: Move a mission HUNT→CHASE. Declares a credit cost and NEVER debits on the first call: it returns requires_confirmation + a single-use confirm_token (valid 300s). Call again with the same step/pace/approach plus confirm_token to execute the debit and start the mission.

description.name: submit_mission_result
description.description: Submit a deliverable for a CHASE mission. Validated against the step's acceptance criteria; on acceptance the mission moves CHASE→FEAST (Kill Confirmed) and IVP is awarded. Steps that require real-world action return status 'awaiting_human_confirmation' and are never auto-completed.

description.name: get_player_status
description.description: The caller's wolf: name, IVP, level, tier (Lone Wolf → Pack Member → Hunter → Alpha), Pack Points, credit balance, tiles completed n/40.

description.name: get_referral_info
description.description: The caller's referral code, redemptions, Pack Points earned from referrals, and free-bag eligibility (free bags require an active Never Run Dry subscription).

description.name: list_pack_hubs
description.description: Pilot Pack Hub café list. Every response includes pilot: true and a note that presence is in pilot.

description.name: get_my_pack
description.description: The caller's pack. On first call the pack is provisioned idempotently with the starter trio (three system starter members); repeat calls never duplicate provisioning.

description.name: get_pack_board
description.description: The caller's pack board state: members, mission, and aggregated member tile progress (n/40).
